# role: fix (the row is there because the extraction or an engine difference left the character wrong without it;
# `part` names the tenant's catalogue parts it carries, comma-separated) | frame (what any port of the character needs
# by design: where it lives, who it is, its move list, a feature; part `-`) | unclear (part `-`).
# `line` is the manifest line `anchor` (a verbatim fragment) is on, within two lines; it lies between the start of the
# nearest comment block above the row's header and the row's last line.
